client_brief:
Five-centre appeal banners with accurate local details and a recovered crest

Alderwood Scholars Fund needs one coordinated banner run for its five centres. The office must be able to trust each centre's name, address, hours and coordinator, not proofread five designs assembled independently from memory.

Our photographs were taken throughout the year by volunteers and borrowed cameras. Please bring them together without making the sourced frame for the thinly covered centre look like a different campaign.

Five banners, one page per centre, produced as a genuine record per page run from the printer's own artwork at the dimensions the printer supplied, each carrying that centre's own name, address, hours and coordinator with nothing truncated at trim and its own prepared photograph bound through the image column, at true press resolution, with a printer note stating exactly what the converted artwork does and does not carry.

A year of volunteer and borrowed camera photography from five centres brought to one house look: one white point, one black point, one warmth, one crop logic, with the sourced frame for the thin centre graded into the same world rather than sitting above it. Delivered with a per-frame parameter log, the centre reconciliation, and every reported resize.

The compound crest recovered from a photograph of an enamel sign as placeable scalable vector geometry: transparent ground, real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle underneath, lamp device and inner rule intact, delivered as a single colour mark and a reverse variant, holding at banner scale seen from the road and at report footer size. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

The crest comes from an enamel-sign photograph. Preserve the lamp and inner rule, and test the mark both at road-viewing banner scale and at a small report footer. Any unresolved fabrication geometry should be clearly marked for supplier review.

We supply alderwood_year_photos/ (about forty frames, five centres); alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf; alderwood_centres.csv; alderwood_centre_outcomes.csv; alderwood_spend_by_programme.csv; eastgate_crest_sign.jpg; alderwood_copy_pack.txt.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note, Stock license and asset IDs and the normalised data and field-mapping record, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise.

Budget: $6,000-$12,000 fixed. Target: 4 to 6 weeks. Reviews: Direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Freelancer.com large format banner brief from a local tutoring institute wanting a "clean, premium, professional" flex banner that stays readable from the road, with subject hinting devices, a confident but minimal photograph of students, understated geometric elements and a print ready CMYK PDF, plus its companion multi branch banner run where every branch carries its own address block. Both are laundered here to the coined, secular, IP clean Alderwood Scholars Fund in Providence, Rhode Island, and the regional festival season is replaced by the Western year end giving season, since every branch locality in the source is a generic address string rather than a real institution. Co-anchors: the Upwork twentieth anniversary commemorative poster brief, which asked for landmarks and community traditions woven into one cohesive composition in a "festival posters, folk-art illustration, screenprint aesthetics" register (the real client is a named Louisiana school, fully laundered), and the marketplace production brief asking for an approved mark turned into production ready files for a scholarship funding drop. The ledger's verdict is STRENGTHEN, and the concept survives whole. It is repositioned only where the connector demands it: from scratch folk illustration and regional script typesetting are not connector work, so the poster directions are built from a recovered crest, graded photography and authored vector rather than illustrated, and the per branch run becomes a genuine record per page merge off the printer's own artwork, which CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) verifies end to end.

price_band_and_audience: An average gift of 45 dollars alongside major asks of 5,000 to 50,000, from donors aged 45 to 70 who are mission motivated and who inspect the overhead ratio before the narrative. The band is load-bearing. Trust at this level is bought with restrained grounds, honest photography, evidence led charts and a spend table that reconciles in public, and every visible dollar of production has to look like it came out of an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer. Push into glossy fundraising grammar, heavy gradients, urgency banners, countdown devices, stock smiles and a saturated hero, and this specific donor reads wasted overhead and gives less, which is the one failure mode that costs the client real money. Push the other way into austere charity minimalism, grey text on grey, no faces, no numbers, and a fifty thousand dollar ask has nothing to stand on. The twentieth year also has to feel like a milestone without becoming a celebration of the organisation rather than the students. A real posted commission of this shape runs 1,500 to 3,500 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.sector: An education charity running five after school learning centres and a small scholarship fund across greater Providence.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2006, greater Providence, Rhode Island, four staff, a volunteer board and five centres.
brand_identity.about: Alderwood Scholars Fund runs five after school learning centres and a scholarship fund for students across greater Providence. This winter marks our twentieth year. The year end appeal carries roughly half our giving, and it works because donors trust that the money reaches the students rather than the overhead. We show our numbers plainly, name where every dollar went, and let the work speak.
brand_identity.audience: Mission motivated donors aged forty five to seventy who give because they believe in the work. Several read the overhead ratio before the narrative and reward organisations that look like they spend on students, not on production.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Average gift 45 dollars, major asks 5,000 to 50,000. Community scale and grassroots: careful and credible rather than glossy, every visible dollar of production reading as an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer.
brand_identity.typography: A humanist serif for headlines and the twentieth year milestone, with a plain humanist sans for body, captions and tables. Numbers set in a clear tabular figure so charts and the spend breakdown read honestly. The feel is settled and civic, not corporate.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, specific, quietly proud. It credits students and staff, states periods on every figure, and never begs. Example line the brand would write: "Last year, ninety students finished the programme. Here is where your gift went, line by line."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The crest was drawn by a trustee in 2006 and the artwork files are long gone. The only surviving version is the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre, which we have as a single handheld photograph. There is no vector, no guideline sheet and no recorded palette or type.
brand_identity.values: Money goes to students, and the books reconcile in public.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_year_photos/ (about forty frames, five centres)
assets_supplied.kind: A year of photography from the five centres, mostly volunteer phone frames, a handful from a borrowed camera, no shot list and no consistent naming.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Everything we have from the year. The Eastgate folder is thin."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two centre folders contain the same evening in the same room from the same camera, filed twice under different centre names, so the set silently represents four centres rather than five. A further handful are re exports of phone screenshots that sit far below the pixel scale a banner frame needs, and reaching that frame means enlargement the crop tool will perform up to its own cap while reporting it only inside its returned tradeoff record.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: Last year's appeal banner as the printer supplied it, artwork built at quarter scale for large format output, with a centre name, a street address, an hours line and a coordinator line.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Last year's banner from our printer. They want the same file back with each centre's own details."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The four lines that print as four tidy separate lines do not have to convert into four mappable frames, and the readout of that block can omit one run while keeping its line break, so every offset past the omission is short and the mapping still reports as valid. The document also carries no bleed of any kind, which the printed sheet gives no sign of.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_centres.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The five centres with name, street address, opening hours and coordinator, prepared by the office manager.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our five centres exactly as they should appear on the banners."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: One centre's hours string is several times longer than the others because it lists term time and holiday hours separately, and a fixed text frame does not spill when it runs out of room, it simply stops rendering at the frame edge while the merge reports success. One coordinator row also carries a trailing honorific the others do not.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_centre_outcomes.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The treasurer's per-centre enrolment, attendance, completion and outcome figures.
assets_supplied.visible_description: The centre outcomes as the treasurer exported them.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Cranston Fields' outcome (1.2) silently covers nine months, not twelve, because it opened last September, and no column states the period. Attendance is formatted inconsistently as percentages, a decimal and a value with a space before the percent sign.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_spend_by_programme.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The treasurer's spend lines by programme, including the audited total.
assets_supplied.visible_description: The spend lines as the treasurer exported them. The total at the bottom is the audited figure.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The restricted 15,000 dollar Ferra Family STEM Grant is entered against two programmes, so the ten spend lines sum to 453,000 against the audited total of 438,000. Amounts mix commas, dollar signs and bare integers.

assets_supplied.name: eastgate_crest_sign.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre: a compound lockup of small caps type set around a ring, with a lamp device inside it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only place our crest still exists as artwork. The original was drawn by a trustee in 2006."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a compound lockup on a photographed enamel surface, so a prompt naming the sign returns the sign rather than the ink, and a compound prompt can return the type ring while silently dropping the lamp and the inner rule. The enclosed counters inside the ring cannot be punched by background removal, which hands back a solid opaque disc, and on the sunlit half the ink runs close in value to the weathered enamel.

assets_supplied.kind: Approved copy: the three centre stories, the appeal language, the trustee list, the donor honour roll of roughly three hundred and forty names, and the two ask amounts.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The copy as the board approved it. The honour roll cannot lose a single name."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed frame can actually live beside this photography. Everything visible while choosing is a small catalogue thumbnail, and the frame's true colour, contrast, grain and depth of field only exist after the full resolution download. Laid beside volunteer phone frames that have been pulled to one modest house target, a professionally lit frame can sit at a different level of finish entirely and read as bought, which is the precise thing this donor punishes. Whether the two can be brought to a common target, and what that target then costs the rest of the set, is only visible with the frames adjacent at full resolution.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering changes when this fires, not whether: even licensing first still requires downloading and placing the frame beside a graded set to know. Nothing states it, because the brief says only that one centre has nothing usable and asks for something honest that fits. The response is not a re run either, since the usual resolution is to move the house target itself, which re grades the whole selection, or to license a different frame chosen on different grounds.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re judge the house target with both families adjacent, re grade the volunteer set toward the new target, or abandon the licensed frame and license a different one on the light it carries rather than the subject it shows, then re cut every banner and report frame already cropped from the old grade.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An impact report and a banner run in which one centre is represented by an obviously purchased photograph sitting a level of polish above the real work, in front of donors who read production spend as overhead.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's banner artwork actually becomes once converted. The printed banner shows a centre name, a street line, an hours line and a coordinator line as four separate lines, but the conversion does not have to expose four mappable frames: a continuous block can arrive as one story, in which case fields must be placed by position inside that story rather than by frame. Worse, the readout of that story can omit an entire run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length, and the mapping still reports as valid and the template preparation still reports success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Frame granularity is a property of the conversion rather than a choice, and nothing about the printed sheet predicts it, so no ordering and no care establishes it without converting and inspecting. Nothing in the brief states it, since the client says only that the printer wants the same file back with each centre's details. The resolution is a different mapping computed against the true story text recovered from the round tripped document, not a repeat of the same call.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild every offset from the true story text, re prepare the template, re verify that each placeholder is genuinely present rather than trusting the success message, and only then merge, since a template short two fields merges five silently incomplete banners.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Five large format banners going to the printer with the hours line or the coordinator line missing or displaced on every one of them, paid for at large format prices and hung outside five centres for the whole appeal.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the honour roll. Three hundred and forty names set the obvious way, as a multi column flow so they fit the page, come back as a single reflowed column: the multi column construction is discarded outright, the text runs down past the bottom of the fixed canvas, and the response reports success with no warning of any kind. The roll sits on the later pages of the report, and the document's rendition returns the first page only, so the returned per page markup is the sole channel in which any of this is visible, including whether the names that ran off the canvas are merely below the fold or genuinely absent.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: The normalisation happens at import, which is the last step, so no ordering precedes it, and getting it right first time would mean knowing which of several reasonable ways to set a long list survives, which no tool reports and no checklist enumerates. Nothing in the brief states it, since the client says only that the roll is long and cannot lose a name. The response is a different construction, explicit sibling columns rather than a flowed one, plus a re judged page break, which changes the document rather than repeating it.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re author the roll as explicit side by side columns with the break decided by hand, re balance the pages after it, re run the readiness check, re export, and audit every page from the returned markup rather than from the first page.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An annual report delivered to a board with an unknown number of donors' names silently off the canvas, on the one page of the document those donors will look for themselves in first.

decision_gates: Which deliverables need free form fixed canvas authoring and which need the one surface that yields a press resolution file, given that neither can do the other's job.
Whether the photographic library really covers five centres, and how to tell a client that two of its folders are the same room.
How far to push a phone frame toward the house target before it stops being worth saving, against naming it and using fewer, better pictures.
Whether the licensed frame joins the house look or the house look moves to meet it, and what that costs the rest of the set.

Selection wording on the enamel sign: naming the sign takes the enamel, naming the ink's own visual properties takes the crest, and background removal on an enclosed ring is the wrong instrument entirely.
Which crest variant carries the banners, judged at the size a banner is actually read from rather than at full canvas.
How to treat a spend file that does not reconcile to its own audited total: correct it visibly, footnote it, or refuse to chart it, on a piece read by donors who check exactly this.
Whether to label, footnote or drop the outcome figure that covers nine months, on a chart whose neighbours cover twelve.

The crest is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent ground, scalable with a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle underneath, its lamp and inner rule intact, and it still reads at the size it reproduces at on a banner seen from the road and in a report footer.
In every delivered document the crest is live vector geometry and every word is text the client can retype next year.

Five banners, one page per centre, each carrying its own name, address, hours and coordinator with nothing truncated at trim, at true press resolution rather than screen resolution, and delivered to the printer's own artwork dimensions.
One type system, one palette and one grammar across report, deck, posters, appeal set and banners.
Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.
Final files open successfully, use unambiguous names, match the stated dimensions and formats, and include editable sources only where the scoped deliverable requires them.
Production-readiness claims are limited to geometry that can be inspected; vectorization alone is never accepted as evidence of fabrication readiness.

why_not_vlm: Paste this brief and these assets into a frontier image model and it returns a handsome charity report about nobody. IDENTITY: these are this organisation's actual students, its actual five centres with their actual addresses and coordinators, and a crest drawn by a trustee in 2006 that must be recovered from the only surviving artefact rather than reinvented, because a regenerated crest belongs to no one. SPEC: five pages, one per centre, on the printer's own artwork at the printer's dimensions and at press resolution, three appeal canvases at three exact sizes in one file, and an honour roll of roughly three hundred and forty names in which every single name must be present, none of which a generated image satisfies or can be checked for. EDITABILITY: the entire engagement exists because the figures change every year and this client cannot commission it again. And the middle of the work is verification against material reality: does this licensed frame sit with the real photography, did the conversion expose the fields the printed banner implied, did the last name in the roll survive the page.
